digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Reviewer prompts and criteria routing index use dual vocabulary ('success criteria' and 'acceptance criteria') that pools them under a single bar, introducing noise in rubrics and the generated criteria guide.

All 11 in-scope occurrences of 'Success Criteria' and 'success criteria' in reviewer prompts and routing must be renamed to 'Acceptance Criteria' and 'acceptance criteria', with 3 deliberately excluded sites (T2's pilot metrics wording and dod_uncertifiable definitions) left untouched.

Rotating the criteria_routing.json file invalidates outstanding plan-review attestations via stale-regver, but this is safe to make after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053) merges and establishes grandfathering at the claim gate.

The generated criteria guide must be regenerated via the registry command to reflect the vocabulary consolidation, retaining its GENERATED banner and carrying exactly one 'success criteria' match (from T2's excluded phrase).
